determinism: no randomness; content-hashed ids; sorted output; unordered results sorted; cases Spark analyzes as non-deterministic or CURRENT_LIKE (incl. seeded rand/uuid/shuffle), value_unstable_functions, and outputs with JVM identity hashes record schema only
case_format: one JSON object per line: id, function, kind, sql, conf (overrides of base_conf; mode-independent); family = the shard's family; per mode (ansi_on, ansi_off) either {schema, rows, render, ordered, truncated, typed_rows | typed_unavailable}, {schema?, error{error_class, sqlstate, message, message_parameters, phase, stability?}}, {schema, nondeterministic}, or {same_as: <mode>}
typed_cell_format: JSON null = SQL NULL; bool/int as JSON; string as JSON string or {utf8_hex}; {f64|f32: IEEE bits hex, repr}; {unscaled, scale}; {ts_us, tz} / {ntz_us}; {days}; {hex}; arrays as JSON arrays; {map: [[k, v]]}; {struct: [[name, v]]}

edge_catalog.null: typed NULL of the argument's type
edge_catalog.decimal38_max_frac: DECIMAL(38,18) with 20 integral and 18 fractional nines
edge_catalog.invalid_utf8: CAST(X'C328FF' AS STRING): bytes that are not valid UTF-8
edge_catalog.unicode: multi-byte string (accents, CJK, emoji, combining mark)
edge_catalog.whitespace: string padded with ASCII and Unicode whitespace
edge_catalog.empty_array: empty array of the argument's type
edge_catalog.array_of_null: single-NULL-element array of the argument's type
edge_catalog.empty_map: empty map of the argument's type
edge_catalog.rows_int_max: aggregate input: two integral-maximum rows (sum overflow)
edge_catalog.rows_decimal38: aggregate input: two DECIMAL(38,18) maxima (sum overflow)
